$comment: Smart Turn v3.2 end-of-turn classifier (speech::smart_turn::MODEL_ID), owned by P2-C.

pipecat-ai/smart-turn-v3 on Hugging Face (BSD-2-Clause): a Whisper Tiny encoder with a linear head, int8 quantized for the CPU (the 32 MB fp32 '-gpu' export is not listed: Sigil runs it on the CPU, two threads, ~30 ms per pause on the dev PC).

Input contract (checked by speech::smart_turn's tests against transformers' WhisperFeatureExtractor): the last 8 s of 16 kHz mono audio, zero-padded at the start, zero-mean / unit-variance normalized, 80-bin Whisper log-mel [1, 80, 800] as 'input_features'; output: the turn-end probability (sigmoid).
Update: pin with scripts/models/pin-catalog.mjs --fragment src-tauri/model-catalog/smart-turn.json --write, and keep MODEL_ID / MODEL_FILE in speech/smart_turn.rs in step.

entries.title: Smart Turn v3.2
entries.description: Recognizes when you have finished speaking, so translation, text-to-speech and the VRChat chatbox can send sooner. Captions are unaffected. About 9 MB download.
